interface.name: zwwm_focus_grab_manager_v1

description.summary: dismissible keyboard focus for layer panels

interface.description: A client can grab keyboard focus for its own layer surface and its subsurfaces/popups. Clicking or touching outside dismisses the grab; the client handles dismissed by hiding or unmapping its panel. Outside activation is consumed, including the matching pointer release.

request.name: activate
request.description: A mapped panel receives focus immediately. An unmapped panel is armed until it maps. One grab is active per seat; another activation dismisses the previous grab. A dismissed object can be activated again.
